about.title: Software Engineer
about.aboutText: As a Systems and Computing Engineering graduate from EIA University, I'm passionate about software development and technological innovation. Skilled in web and mobile development using Python, Java, Go, and Flutter, I craft dynamic, responsive, and cross-platform solutions.

experiences.summary: Led technical direction and development of enterprise applications on the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
highlights: Led development of an enterprise resource management app using React, TypeScript, and Microsoft Power Platform.
Designed role-based access control integrating Microsoft Entra ID and Dataverse.
Created Azure Pipelines for automated deployment with multi-environment support.
Led research and development of Autodesk platform integration including 3D model viewing.
Built Power Automate cloud flows and integrated Dataverse environment variables.

experiences.summary: Designed and built AI agents and RAG systems for child nutrition monitoring and strategic analysis.
highlights: Built intelligent agents using SmolAgents and LangGraph with OpenAI models via Azure.
Developed RAG systems for document indexing, summarization, and retrieval.
Built the ANSI Automatic Extractor using AWS Lambda, S3, ECR, and API Gateway.

experiences.summary: Contributed to digitization of field visit processes and development of data processing tools.
highlights: Replaced manual Excel process with a smart form in Survey123.
Developed a desktop app using Python and Flet for data processing with AI-powered voice transcription.
Packaged the application as an executable installer for Windows.

experiences.summary: Full Stack Developer skilled in Go, TypeScript, Java, and Python.
highlights: Designed, implemented, and maintained software features.
Participated in development sprints with clean coding practices.
